CheatCodes.faqQuestion1: How do I enter cheat codes in GTA 6?
CheatCodes.faqAnswer1: On PS5 and Xbox, press the button sequence during gameplay. On PC, enter the keyword via the in-game phone or directly on the keyboard. Codes activate immediately on screen.
CheatCodes.faqQuestion2: Do GTA 6 cheat codes disable trophies?
CheatCodes.faqAnswer2: Yes, as in previous GTA games, using cheat codes disables trophy/achievement progress during the active session. Save before using cheats if you want to keep access to trophies.
CheatCodes.faqQuestion3: Are cheat codes the same on PS5, Xbox and PC?
CheatCodes.faqAnswer3: No. On PS5 and Xbox, cheats use different button sequences. On PC, cheats use keywords typed on the keyboard. The effect is the same, only the input method differs.
CheatCodes.faqQuestion4: Are there cheat codes for GTA 6 Online?
CheatCodes.faqAnswer4: No. Cheat codes only work in story mode (single-player). Using cheats or modifications online is prohibited and can result in a permanent ban.
CheatCodes.faqQuestion5: When will GTA 6 cheat codes be available?
CheatCodes.faqAnswer5: Cheat codes will be confirmed and published when the game releases on November 19, 2026. The codes listed are based on previous games and will be verified at launch.
CheatCodes.faqQuestion6: Where can I find all GTA 6 cheat codes?
CheatCodes.faqAnswer6: All GTA 6 cheat codes for PS5, Xbox and PC are listed on this page. They'll be updated when the game releases on November 19, 2026. Also check our dedicated pages: PS5 cheats, Xbox cheats and PC cheats.
